classification: Actual native geometry plus manufacturer application comparison; NOT an ESD qualification
selected: Retain U3 pin5=V3V3; no schematic or USB-layout change
ST_reference: DS4260 Rev7 Figure13 upstream3.3V transceiver, Figure14 VCC-bias example, sections2.1..2.3 rail-to-rail mechanism/short VCC-GND-I/O connections

ground_returns.qualification: Distance only; F.Cu/B.Cu filled-ground continuity confirmed by DRC and IPC. Not a measured inductance.

capacitance.warning: Charge division is illustrative only; package TVS, diode current sharing and PCB Ldi/dt dominate IEC pulses. No guaranteed3.3V rail clamp at IEC stress.

positive_current_path: Connector data -> U3 upper steering diode -> local pin5/C10 rail -> internal transil and ground pin2; some charge may disturbV3V3. Main buck cannot be assumed to sink ESD.
negative_current_path: LocalGND -> U3 lower steering diode -> data terminal; layout inductance adds residual voltage.

alternatives.A_V3V3: Selected; documented rail-to-rail mechanism and5.25V working rating; common rail stays biased when battery-powered. Does not charge absentUSB_VBUS via self-powered data pull-up.
alternatives.B_raw_USB_VBUS: Not selected; absentVBUS can be charged by self-powered D+ upper steering, interfering with GPIO37 VBUS detection; higher powered clamp bias and no demonstrated benefit.
alternatives.C_rail_less_ESD: Would avoid rail charge-sharing but requires new MPN/landing and residual-clamp review; no demonstrated steady-state defect in A justifies that change.

unpowered_host: Compliant host does not actively drive an unattached peripheral before pull-up. Host-signal misuse/3.3V regulator failure can inject through U3 intoV3V3; this is not an arbitrary-powered-off data isolation device. Verify attachment/reset/backfeed physically; no claim of zero leakage under an externally forced data line.
